title: Breaking Down Video LLM Benchmarks: Knowledge, Spatial Perception, or True Temporal Understanding?

bias_targets.methodology: Providing multimodal LLMs with questions without the accompanying video inputs to test if the models rely on pre-trained factual language knowledge (answer leakage) rather than visual evidence.
Randomly shuffling the temporal order of extracted video frames and querying the models to determine if they rely on static, frame-level semantic cues rather than true temporal reasoning.
